gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients diagnosed as ovarian cancer, non-small cell lung cancer, breast cancer, gastric cancer, head and neck cancer, pancreatic cancer, colorectal cancer, transitional cell carcinoma, endometrial carcinoma, sarcoma, glioblastoma, cholangiocarcinoma, etc. have received standard systemic treatment

candidate_evidence.quote: Dual-targeting HER2 and PD-L1 CAR-T cell therapy

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: have received standard systemic treatment, have systemic metastasis/serosal cavity metastasis or are not tolerated;

agents.agent_name_registered: Dual-targeting HER2 and PD-L1 CAR-T cells

role_evidence.quote: all enrolled subjects will receive HER2/PD-L1 CAR T cells via intravenous or thoracic/peritoneal cavity infusion.

biomarkers.biomarker_other: HER2 expression >20% by IHC or FISH

source_quote.quote: Expressing HER2 \>20% of primary tumors or metastatic cells in the serous cavity by immunohistochemistry (IHC) or fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH);

coder_notes: Early Phase 1 HER2-positive solid-tumour basket; glioblastoma explicitly listed among eligible tumour types in inclusion criteria. Only intervention is a CAR-T cell therapy (excluded type). HER2 entry requirement is target-matched to the CAR-T, but CAR-T is not a candidate, so candidate_matched=false. PD-L1 is a CAR target, not a selection biomarker.
